steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract song entries
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        entry = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get title and artists
        parts = entry.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artists_str = parts[1].strip()
            # Remove "RELEASED_AT ..." part
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in artists_str:
                artists_str = artists_str.split(' RELEASED_AT ')[0]
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(songs)

# Let's write a function to find the release month for each song
import re

def get_release_month(song_title, song_artists):
    # Search for the song on Spotify
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=song_title, page_limit=20)
    for song in results:
        # Check if title matches exactly
        if song['title'].lower() == song_title.lower():
            # Check if artists match
            song_artist_names = [a['name'] for a in song['artists']]
            # Compare sets of artist names (case-insensitive)
            if set([a.lower() for a in song_artist_names]) == set([a.lower() for a in song_artists]):
                # Extract release date
                release_date = song['release_date']  # e.g., "2022-12-11T06:22:44"
                # Parse month and year
                year = release_date[:4]
                month = release_date[5:7]
                return f"{month}/{year}"
    return None

# Test with one song
print(get_release_month('Tangled Lies', ['Ava Morgan']))
